user.title: RF Network
user.description:
Control fixed-code RF devices (ceiling fans, shades, lights, plug-in remotes) through one or more ESPHome RF gateways running the RF Network firmware. Gateways are found automatically.

In the ESPHome integration, turn on **Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions** for every gateway, or received codes will not reach Home Assistant.

Pick the template for the device's brand. Press a button on its remote first and RF Network suggests a match.

device_details.title: Add a device: {template}
device_details.description: The address is the {bits}-bit part of the code unique to this device, e.g. `{example}`. If you just pressed a button on its remote, it is filled in. This template uses {frequency} MHz; it is sent through a gateway on that band.

data_description.gateway: Automatic sends through the gateway on the right band that most recently heard this device's remote.

add_learned.title: Add a remote from learned codes
add_learned.description:
For remotes no template covers. Press a button, copy the code from the RF Network Last code sensor (or the raw code from Last unrecognised signal), and add one line per button:
`Button name = aircool_12:010101110111`

Last code: `{last_code}`

data.burst_gap_ms: Silence that ends a remote press
data.echo_window_ms: Ignore echoes of our own commands for

data_description.repeat_count: How many times each code is sent, unless the template sets its own. Too few and the device may miss it; too many and a light toggle can turn into dimming.
data_description.burst_gap_ms: Captures of the same code closer together than this count as one press.
data_description.echo_window_ms: After sending, other gateways hear our own signal. Codes we just sent are ignored for this long.

error.invalid_address: The address must be exactly the template's number of 0/1 digits.
error.address_in_use: Another device of this template already uses this address. Two devices with the same address always react together; change the address (e.g. DIP switches) on one of them.
error.name_in_use: Enter a name that is not already used by another device.
error.invalid_buttons: Some lines could not be read.

abort.no_templates: No templates could be loaded. Check the Home Assistant log for template errors.

missing_templates.description: These devices use a template that could not be loaded, so they are not set up: {devices}. Check the Home Assistant log for template errors, or restore the template file.
